She was at her door at about 7:10pm. Delivery events show picked_up at 18:35 and handoff at 19:02, method left_at_door, with photo proof PH-55120 showing the bag at the door of apartment 1204. Since the handoff has photo proof and the customer disputes receipt, no refund or credit was issued. Needs specialist review of the delivery dispute.

events.text:
Thank you, Hana. Your identity is verified.

I checked order Q-7501 from Big Slice Pizza. Here's what our records show:

- The courier picked up the order at 6:35pm.
- It was handed over at 7:02pm, left at your apartment door (Apt 1204, 300 Tower Blvd). The courier's photo of the bag at your door is on file.

Because there is photo proof of delivery, I can't issue a refund or credit myself. I've escalated the case to a human specialist (reference ESC-700), who will follow up within 24 hours. I've included your account of not finding the order at your door.

In the meantime, please check around your apartment entrance, with neighbors, or with building staff in case the bag was moved. If you find anything or have more details, reply here and I'll add them to the case.

The photo is the part that doesn't make sense to me. I checked my door at 7:10 and there was nothing there. My building has had packages go missing before, so someone could have taken it from the hallway or the entrance. I'm not going to go door to door asking neighbors when I paid for food I never got.

I need a refund, not a 24-hour wait. Can you at least tell me whether the specialist can refund me directly, or do I have to keep chasing this?

I understand the frustration, especially since you paid for food you didn't get.

I can't issue a refund myself in this case. When a delivery has photo proof and the customer says it didn't arrive, our policy requires a specialist to review it. I also can't promise what the specialist will decide.

You don't need to keep chasing it. Your case (ESC-700) is with a human specialist, who will follow up with you within 24 hours. You don't need to contact anyone else or search your building. If you find out anything more, like a neighbor or building staff who saw the bag, reply here and I'll add it to the case so the specialist has it.

If you'd rather talk to a person now instead of waiting, tell me and I'll request that.

Ok, but I'm not happy about it. The specialist better be able to actually refund me, not just look at a photo and say no. I'll wait for their email within 24 hours.

Yes, I'd rather talk to a person now if that's possible. Can you request that? I don't want to wait another day for this.

args.summary: Customer Hana Sato (verified) asked to speak to a person about order Q-7501 (Big Slice Pizza, $46.84), which was marked delivered at 19:02 with left_at_door photo proof PH-55120, but she says it never arrived and she was at her door at about 7:10pm. She wants a refund and is unhappy with the outcome. Earlier escalation ESC-700 (delivery_dispute) is open. No refund or credit has been issued. She wants to speak to someone now rather than wait 24 hours.

I'll wait for them to reach out.
